basic_info.description: Your stunning penthouse home awaits at this very special, house-like condo,  situated in a lovely 3-unit building (each with a private entrance).   Welcome to 2871 Clay Street; located just steps from Alta Plaza park on a coveted, tree-lined block of Clay (which is also a SLOW STREET).  Easily walk to Fillmore and Sacramento Streets for dining and shopping, or hop on your bike and cruise into the Presidio. You'll marvel at the: high ceilings, period details (beautifully combined with modern design), natural light, open floor plan, wood-burning fireplace, chef's kitchen, bar area,  and so much more! There are 3 bedrooms; the large primary suite boasts lovely southern city views, a spacious walk-in closet, marble bath equipped with a soaking tub and a separate shower and a small deck.  In addition  there are 2  other bedrooms, a full marble bath, and a large purpose-built office/writer's paradise!  Conveniently located in the hall is a laundry room with stacked washer/dryer, cupboards and storage. One car parking and additional storage complete this very special Pacific Heights home.
